name: Become Brutes
oracle_text: One or two target creatures each gain haste until end of turn. For each of those creatures, create a Monster Role token attached to it. (If you control another Role on it, put that one into the graveyard. Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has trample.)

all_parts.name: Monster // Sorcerer
all_parts.type_line: Token Enchantment — Aura Role // Token Enchantment — Aura Role

name: Choking Vines
oracle_text:
Cast this spell only during the declare blockers step.
X target attacking creatures become blocked. Choking Vines deals 1 damage to each of those creatures. (This spell works on creatures that can't be blocked.)

name: Concerted Defense
oracle_text: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {1} plus an additional {1} for each creature in your party. (Your party consists of up to one each of Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard.)
flavor_text: "You mess with one of us, you mess with all of us!"

name: Display of Power
oracle_text:
This spell can't be copied.
Copy any number of target instant and/or sorcery spells. You may choose new targets for the copies.
set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
flavor_text:
"The Nazgûl closed round at night, and I was besieged. Such light and flame cannot have been seen on Weathertop since the war-beacons of old."
—Gandalf

name: Drag the Canal
oracle_text: Create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token. If a creature died this turn, you gain 2 life, surveil 2, then investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
flavor_text: "Let's gather what we can before the Golgari tidy up the scene."

name: Druidic Ritual
oracle_text: You may mill three cards. Then return up to one creature card and up to one land card from your graveyard to your hand. (To mill a card, put the top card of your library into your graveyard.)
set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
flavor_text: Bone, root, and seed—the past, the present, and future in one handful of earth.

name: Eliminate the Impossible
oracle_text: Investigate. Creatures your opponents control get -2/-0 until end of turn. If any of them are suspected, they're no longer suspected. (To investigate, create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
flavor_text: "Half the city had motive. Time to narrow down who also had the means and opportunity."

name: Ember Gale
oracle_text: Creatures target player controls can't block this turn. Ember Gale deals 1 damage to each white and/or blue creature that player controls.
flavor_text:
"Terrible wind. It whipped sparks into our skin, then stoked them even hotter!"
—Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain

name: Embiggen
oracle_text: Until end of turn, target non-Brushwagg creature gets +1/+1 for each supertype, card type, and subtype it has.
flavor_text: "Flea circus? No, flee circus!"

name: Encircling Fissure
oracle_text:
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn by creatures target opponent controls.
Awaken 2—{4}{W} (If you cast this spell for {4}{W}, also put two +1/+1 counters on target land you control and it becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste. It's still a land.)

name: Fractalize
oracle_text: Until end of turn, target creature becomes a green and blue Fractal with base power and toughness each equal to X plus 1. (It loses all other colors and creature types.)
flavor_text:
"Return your lizards to their natural size before class ends. We don't want another incident."
—Professor Berta

name: Full Steam Ahead
oracle_text: Until end of turn, each creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains trample and "This creature can't be blocked by more than one creature."
flavor_text: The runaway train tore through the manicured streets of Prosperity, its new conductors reveling in the sheer destruction.

name: Grasping Tentacles
oracle_text: Target opponent mills eight cards. You may put an artifact card from that player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.

name: Hide in Plain Sight
oracle_text: Look at the top five cards of your library, cloak two of them, and put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. (To cloak a card, put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature with ward {2}. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
flavor_text: The trees look beautiful... until they look back.

name: Incremental Growth
oracle_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature, two +1/+1 counters on another target creature, and three +1/+1 counters on a third target creature.
flavor_text:
"Tie a mouse under a bridge, and your cabbages will triple in size."
—Kithkin superstition

name: Irencrag Feat
oracle_text: Add seven {R}. You can cast only one more spell this turn.
flavor_text: The greatest challenge isn't the stifling heat but the crushing weight of those who failed before.

name: Karn's Touch
oracle_text: Target noncreature artifact becomes an artifact creature with power and toughness each equal to its mana value until end of turn. (It retains its abilities.)

name: Mercadia's Downfall
oracle_text: Each attacking creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each nonbasic land defending player controls.
flavor_text: With an explosion that shook the foundation of the city, the *Weatherlight* burst from the underground hangar.

name: Moonmist
oracle_text: Transform all Humans. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn by creatures other than Werewolves and Wolves. (Only double-faced cards can be transformed.)

name: Nightmare Incursion
oracle_text: Search target player's library for up to X cards, where X is the number of Swamps you control, and exile them. Then that player shuffles.

name: Outmaneuver
oracle_text: X target blocked creatures assign their combat damage this turn as though they weren't blocked.
flavor_text:
"Push one goblin into sight, an' run a lot. That's tactics."
—Jula, goblin raider

name: Risk Factor
oracle_text:
Target opponent may have Risk Factor deal 4 damage to them. If that player doesn't, you draw three cards.
Jump-start (You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs. Then exile this card.)

name: Rune Snag
oracle_text: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {2} plus an additional {2} for each card named Rune Snag in each graveyard.
flavor_text:
"Concentration is key. Without it, a mage conjures nothing but a splitting headache."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Sanctified Charge
oracle_text: Creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn. White creatures you control also gain first strike until end of turn. (They deal combat damage before creatures without first strike.)
flavor_text: You need only raise your spear to receive this blessing.

name: Serene Remembrance
oracle_text: Shuffle Serene Remembrance and up to three target cards from a single graveyard into their owners' libraries.
flavor_text: While Lazav schemed and Niv-Mizzet researched, Trostani sought the future in the whispers of the past.

name: Surrounded by Orcs
oracle_text: Amass Orcs 3, then target player mills X cards, where X is the amassed Army's power. (To amass Orcs 3, put three +1/+1 counters on an Army you control. It's also an Orc. If you don't control an Army, create a 0/0 black Orc Army creature token first.)
set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

name: Swallowed by Leviathan
oracle_text: Choose target spell. Surveil 2, then counter the chosen spell unless its controller pays {1} for each card in your graveyard. (To surveil 2, look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)

name: Swarm Surge
oracle_text:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn. Colorless creatures you control also gain first strike until end of turn.
flavor_text: The Eldrazi rampaged across Zendikar in a tide of chittering, heaving flesh.

name: Terrifying Presence
oracle_text: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt by creatures other than target creature this turn.
flavor_text: Elmut had slaughtered vampires, slain werewolves, and destroyed hordes of zombies. Sadly, he never got over his fear of spiders.

name: Turn the Earth
oracle_text:
Choose up to three target cards in graveyards. The owners of those cards shuffle them into their libraries. You gain 2 life.
Flashback {1}{G} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

name: Waxing Moon
oracle_text: Transform up to one target Werewolf you control. Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
flavor_text:
"Show them what it means to be the source of nightmares!"
—Ulrich, Krallenhorde alpha

name: Write into Being
oracle_text: Look at the top two cards of your library. Manifest one of those cards, then put the other on the top or bottom of your library. (To manifest a card, put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)

name: Flame Spill
oracle_text: Flame Spill deals 4 damage to target creature. Excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
flavor_text: Fragile, floating Skysail suddenly seemed like an appealingly safe place to live.

name: Pigment Storm
oracle_text: Pigment Storm deals 5 damage to target creature. Excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
flavor_text: When art projects collapse, Prismari students revel in the beauty of destruction. Everyone else runs for cover.
